skills.label: Champion kit
skills.desc: A playbook for engineers advocating Claude Code internally: what to share, how to answer questions, and how to grow adoption on your team. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/champion-kit

skills.label: Communications kit
skills.desc: Launch announcements, drip-campaign messages, and FAQ responses for rolling Claude Code out to your engineering organization. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/communications-kit

skills.label: Claude apps gateway for Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry
skills.desc: Run Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Foundry behind a self-hosted gateway with SSO sign-in, per-group model access, and OTLP telemetry. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway

skills.label: Claude apps gateway configuration
skills.desc: Reference for every gateway.yaml option: listener and TLS, OIDC, session, Postgres store, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry upstreams, model routing, managed policies, and telemetry. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway-config

skills.label: Claude apps gateway deployment and operations
skills.desc: Register the gateway with your IdP, build the container, deploy on Kubernetes or Cloud Run, and operate it: health checks, secret rotation, upgrades, and security. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway-deploy

skills.label: Deploy Claude apps gateway on AWS
skills.desc: A worked example of running Claude apps gateway on AWS: ECS Fargate or EKS, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, AWS Secrets Manager, and IAM-role auth to Amazon Bedrock. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway-on-aws

skills.label: Deploy Claude apps gateway on Google Cloud
skills.desc: A worked example of running Claude apps gateway on Google Cloud: Cloud Run or GKE, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, and service-account auth to Google Cloud's Agent Platform. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway-on-gcp

skills.label: Claude apps gateway spend limits
skills.desc: Cap each developer's spend through the Claude apps gateway by day, week, or month. Set limits with an Admin API and the gateway enforces them live on every request. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-apps-gateway-spend-limits

skills.label: Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock
skills.desc: Learn about configuring Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock, including setup, IAM configuration, and troubleshooting. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/amazon-bedrock

skills.label: Claude Code on Claude Platform on AWS
skills.desc: Configure Claude Code to use the Anthropic-operated Claude API with AWS authentication, IAM access control, and AWS Marketplace billing. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-platform-on-aws

skills.label: Run Claude Code behind a corporate launcher
skills.desc: Route the processes Claude Code starts from its own binary, including the background service and every agent view session, through a required launcher with CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER or the processWrapper setting. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/corporate-launcher

skills.label: Development containers
skills.desc: Run Claude Code inside a dev container for consistent, isolated environments across your team. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/devcontainer

skills.label: Feature availability
skills.desc: Compare which Claude Code features are available across Anthropic subscription plans, the Anthropic Console, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/feature-availability

skills.label: Claude Code on Google Cloud's Agent Platform
skills.desc: Learn about configuring Claude Code through Google Cloud's Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI, including setup, IAM configuration, and troubleshooting. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/google-vertex-ai

skills.label: Claude Code on Microsoft Foundry
skills.desc: Learn about configuring Claude Code through Microsoft Foundry, including setup, configuration, and troubleshooting. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/microsoft-foundry

skills.label: Enterprise network configuration
skills.desc: Configure Claude Code for enterprise environments with proxy servers, custom Certificate Authorities (CA), and mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) authentication. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/network-config

skills.label: Enterprise deployment overview
skills.desc: Learn how Claude Code can integrate with various third-party services and infrastructure to meet enterprise deployment requirements. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/third-party-integrations

skills.label: Run Claude Code through a gateway
skills.desc: Route Claude Code through a self-hosted gateway for centralized credentials, usage tracking, and cost controls. Covers the architecture, Anthropic's Claude apps gateway, and using other gateway products. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/gateways

skills.label: Other LLM gateways
skills.desc: Route Claude Code through an LLM gateway your organization already runs. Covers connecting Claude Code to a gateway, rolling one out for your organization, and what Claude Code sends to a gateway. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway

skills.label: Connect Claude Code to an LLM gateway
skills.desc: Point Claude Code at your organization's LLM gateway. Check whether your admin already configured it, or set the base URL and credential yourself, then verify the connection and fix gateway errors. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-connect

skills.label: Claude Code gateway compatibility guide
skills.desc: Keep an LLM gateway compatible with Claude Code: the endpoints it calls, the headers and body fields to forward, and what breaks when they're stripped. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol

skills.label: Roll out an LLM gateway for your organization
skills.desc: Deploy a gateway product for Claude Code: configure it to forward what Claude Code sends, issue developer credentials, distribute the configuration through managed settings, and verify the rollout. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-rollout

skills.label: Data usage
skills.desc: Learn about Anthropic's data usage policies for Claude Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/data-usage

skills.label: Set up Claude Code (local mode) for a HIPAA-ready organization
skills.desc: Prepare developers' computers to run Claude Code (local mode) under the HIPAA configuration. Covers versions, network access, managed settings, and local data. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hipaa-setup

skills.label: Security
skills.desc: Learn about Claude Code's security safeguards and best practices for safe usage. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/security

skills.label: Zero data retention
skills.desc: Learn about Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for Claude Code, available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise, including scope, disabled features, and how to request enablement. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/zero-data-retention

skills.label: Set up Claude Code for your organization
skills.desc: A decision map for administrators deploying Claude Code, covering API providers, managed settings, policy enforcement, usage monitoring, and data handling. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/admin-setup

skills.label: Authentication
skills.desc: Log in to Claude Code and configure authentication for individuals, teams, and organizations. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication

skills.label: Configure auto mode
skills.desc: Tell the auto mode classifier which repos, buckets, and domains your organization trusts. Set environment context, override the default block and allow rules, and inspect your effective config with the auto-mode CLI subcommands. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-config

skills.label: Control MCP server access for your organization
skills.desc: Restrict which MCP servers users can add or connect to, or provide servers to every user, with managed configuration files, managed settings, allowlists, and denylists. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp

skills.label: Deploy managed settings
skills.desc: Deploy managed settings to every developer's machine: delivery mechanisms per OS, how Claude Code combines managed sources, and how to verify enforcement. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-settings

skills.label: Configure server-managed settings
skills.desc: Centrally configure Claude Code for your organization through server-delivered settings, without requiring device management infrastructure. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/server-managed-settings

skills.label: Advanced setup
skills.desc: System requirements, platform-specific installation, version management, and uninstallation for Claude Code. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup

skills.label: Track team usage with analytics
skills.desc: View Claude Code usage metrics, track adoption, and measure engineering velocity in the analytics dashboard. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/analytics

skills.label: Manage costs effectively
skills.desc: Track token usage, set team spend limits, and reduce Claude Code costs with context management, model selection, extended thinking settings, and preprocessing hooks. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/costs

skills.label: Monitoring
skills.desc: Learn how to enable and configure OpenTelemetry for Claude Code. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage
